name: Recurring-report automation sprint
offer: One recurring agency/operations report from at most two authorized CSV exports; validation + reusable pipeline
buyer: Small agencies and operations teams with a named manual reporting bottleneck
risk: Scope creep; buyer can already buy reporting software; sensitive data
channel: Respond to explicit spreadsheet/reporting requests; introductions from web agencies
gate: Three paid scoped deliveries; at least two buyers request repeat runs/care

name: Supplier catalog cleanup
offer: Normalize a supplier CSV, map fields, repair SKUs and produce a dry-run import error report; no live write
risk: Accidental overwrites; dirty source images/data; existing cheap import tools
channel: Merchant requests for failed imports; Shopify agency subcontracting
gate: Two paid files pass a sandbox import; delivery under four hours

name: Agency form-path monitoring
offer: Permission-based checks of two or three critical form paths; test inbox + alert ownership; no repair SLA
buyer: Web agencies maintaining small lead-generation sites
risk: False alerts; browser changes; monitoring expense; clients expect 24/7 repairs
channel: Sell a pilot to an agency managing at least ten sites; use existing service buyers
gate: At least three paying sites; <5% unactionable alerts; under 30 minutes/site/month

name: Purchase-order PDF to validated CSV
offer: One recurring document family; extract agreed fields into a reviewable CSV with arithmetic checks
buyer: Small distributors or ecommerce operations with repeated purchase orders
risk: Wrong quantities/totals; OCR exceptions; commercially confidential inputs
channel: Explicit PDF-to-spreadsheet requests and bookkeeper/operations referrals
gate: Three paid clients with representative files and accepted exception process

name: Licensed report-automation toolkit
offer: Original source code, three tested CSV mappings, fixtures, reports and setup guide; no client data
buyer: Junior freelancers and small agencies who prefer self-service
risk: Free alternatives; no discovery; support takes longer than product margin
channel: Offer as a downsell to qualified service leads; useful authorized community demo
gate: Three paid licenses before expanding; revise if <2 sales from 200 qualified visits

name: Broken webhook/integration repair
offer: Diagnose and repair one existing authorized integration, with retry and duplicate protection
buyer: Small businesses with a failed Zapier/Make/n8n connection
risk: Unknown legacy code; incident urgency; customer credentials
channel: Time-sensitive troubleshooting job requests; one-platform specialization
gate: Only quote after an inspection; stop if fixed-price scope cannot be bounded

name: Spreadsheet refresh/repair
offer: Repair a recurring inventory or operations spreadsheet and add repeatable import checks
buyer: Small businesses already relying on a broken or manual workbook
risk: Opaque formulas; fragile dependencies; user input errors

name: CRM duplicate-cleanup sprint
offer: Audit a client-owned CRM export; propose reversible merges and a prevention rule

channel: CRM consultants and explicit data-cleaning requests; never resell customer records
gate: Every merge reviewed; backups verified before any approved write

name: Authorized export/API connector
offer: Connect one documented customer-authorized API to an agreed CSV export and refresh job
buyer: Small teams using a niche SaaS without the right export
risk: API changes; access approval; weak reuse between customers
channel: Search buyer requests naming the unsupported integration
gate: Two buyers need the same integration; written data access authorization

name: Proposal-document automation
offer: Generate draft proposals from approved intake fields and client-owned templates
risk: Wrong scope/pricing clauses; generic features already available
channel: Partner with a consultant who sees repeated proposal work

name: Batch product-media optimization

buyer: Merchants with frequent product catalog changes

gate: One system of record, one approved mapping, three measured paid deliveries
